name: ARA4018
title: Raw colour in an editor style
summary: Editor styles and themes must use semantic tokens so both themes and game UI starter themes stay consistent.
html:
Editor styles and themes must use semantic tokens so both themes and game UI starter themes stay consistent.

#Common causes

  • A #rrggbb literal in an editor stylesheet or inline style.

#Fixes

  • Replace the literal with a var(--token) from the theme.

  • Code: ARA4018

  • Constant: ui::RAW_COLOR

  • Reported by: ara-ui
